Receipt tool fix (na-prime): pending seal fingerprint declaration; launch comparison stays registered-only; 99/99

First-author decision 10-15 Q1 (na-prime). The merged gate failed in
scripts/supp20_input_receipt.py --selftest because the supp20 registration draft wrote the new
sealed-32 fingerprint (acc7bfa3...) in the same `code_fp <hex>` form as the registered value:
registration_values() saw two values, section 3 read as None, R0 and D1 failed, S0 failed and
S0b raised AttributeError.

- Tool (outside sealed 32 and HANDOVER, no effect on code_fp): registration_values() reads an
  optional `code_fp_pending <64hex>` declaration - none = None (not a problem), two different
  values = R0 problem, equal to the registered value = contradiction = R0 problem (value None
  on a problem). D1 verdict unchanged (checkout = registered); the D1 detail only adds the
  pending value. E2, F5, G5 and all other behaviour unchanged: a pending declaration never
  passes the launch comparison.
- Registration drafts: 194 section 9-8 and supp20 section 9-3 now declare
  `code_fp_pending acc7bfa335ec...` with the note that ratification and re-registration replace
  section 3 with this value and delete the declaration; until then D1/E2 compare the registered
  value. Section 3 (e8b2496b...) unchanged.
- Codex request: new section 9 (what failed, decision, tool, tests, 81/99 -> 99/99, tests-first
  commit 545d7d4fe), Q6, section 8 reproduction lines, section 0 diff scope (tool, inventory
  line), review pin line.
- Evidence: final/scripts__supp20_input_receipt.py_selftest.log (99/99, state pending), README
  section 5, rc.tsv row, SHA256SUMS (sha256sum -c passes). Inventory memo for the receipt tool.
- Checks: receipt selftest 99/99; test_lhs214_model_limit 55/55; check_doc_refs no broken
  references; check_selftest_inventory --quiet all classified. No webapp screen for this tool.

+  이 선언은 지운다 · 그 전 발사 대조 D1 · E2 = 등록 값 그대로").  발사 대조 (컨테이너 D1 · 사전 점검 E2 · 발사 manifest F5 · G5) = **등록 §3 값만** — 대기 선언이 통과시키지 않는다
+  (비준 · 재등록 전 발사 불가 유지).  시험만 선언된 대기 상태를 **정확한 실패 집합** 으로 받는다.
+- **도구** (봉인 32 · HANDOVER 밖 검사 도구 — code_fp 무관): `registration_values()` 에 선택 항목 `code_fp_pending` (정규식 `` `code_fp_pending ([0-9a-f]{64})` `` · 0 개 = None · 문제 아님 ·
